rule_en: can = present ability/permission. could = past general ability or polite requests. be able to fills the gaps: future (will be able to), perfect (have been able to), and one-time past success (was able to — not 'could').
rule_bn: can = বর্তমান সামর্থ্য; could = অতীত সাধারণ সামর্থ্য; নির্দিষ্ট একবারের অতীত সাফল্য → was able to (could নয়); ভবিষ্যৎ → will be able to।

sessions.title: Spot the Error
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the wrong word, then choose the fix.

items.prompt_en: After two hours of debugging, I could finally fix the leak
items.explain_en: A one-time past success → was able to, not 'could'.

items.prompt_en: She will can review the package after the offsite
items.explain_en: Two modals can't stack — future ability → will be able to.

items.prompt_en: When I was a student, I can code all night without coffee
items.explain_en: Past general ability → could.

items.prompt_en: We haven't been able reproduce the bug on staging
items.explain_en: be able TO + base verb.

items.prompt_en: Could you to share the dashboard link in the channel?
items.explain_en: Modal + base verb: Could you share…

items.prompt_en: He cans approve expense reports up to five hundred dollars
items.explain_en: Modals never take -s: he can.

items.prompt_en: I didn't could join the call because my train was underground
items.explain_en: Negative of could = couldn't, no 'did'.

items.prompt_en: Since the upgrade, we can to run the full suite in five minutes
items.explain_en: can + base verb, no 'to'.

items.prompt_en: It would be great to can edit messages after sending
items.explain_en: After 'to', use be able to — modals have no infinitive.

items.prompt_en: Yesterday the intern could deployed to the sandbox on his own
items.explain_en: A specific past achievement → was able to + base.

sessions.title: Choose & Fill
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the correct option or chip.

items.prompt_en: ___ you grab me the error ID from the logs, please?
items.explain_en: Polite request → Could you…

items.prompt_en: After the index rebuild, we ___ query a year of data in seconds.
items.explain_en: Present ability → can / be able to + base.

items.prompt_en: I ___ swim until I was fifteen.
items.explain_en: Past inability → couldn't.

items.prompt_en: By next sprint, you ___ create scratch orgs yourself.
items.explain_en: Future ability → will be able to.

items.prompt_en: Thanks to the proxy logs, we ___ trace the failed request yesterday.
items.explain_en: A specific past success → was/were able to, not 'could'.

items.prompt_en: My grandfather ___ fix almost anything with a screwdriver.
items.explain_en: Past general ability → could.

items.prompt_en: If we add the index, users ___ search by phone number.
items.explain_en: Future result → will be able to.

items.prompt_en: I've never ___ focus in open-plan offices.
items.explain_en: Perfect tense → have/has been able to.

items.prompt_en: ___ I leave early today? My visa appointment is at four.
items.explain_en: Polite permission → Could I…?

items.prompt_en: The new hire ___ already push to the shared sandbox.
items.explain_en: Present permission/ability → can + base.

sessions.title: Build It
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the tiles in the right order. For speak items, say it out loud.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: I can review your pull request after lunch .
items.explain_en: can + base verb for a present offer.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: Could you send me the staging credentials ?
items.explain_en: Polite request: Could you + base verb.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: He could solve the puzzle without any hints .
items.explain_en: could = past general ability.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: We were able to recover every single record .
items.explain_en: One-time past success → were able to.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: You will be able to vote on features next quarter .
items.explain_en: Future ability → will be able to.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: I haven't been able to sleep before big releases .
items.explain_en: Perfect tense → haven't been able to.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: Can the vendor support single sign-on ?
items.explain_en: Ability question: Can + subject + base verb.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: After the patch , users could log in again .
items.explain_en: Restored general ability → could.

items.prompt_en: Politely ask a teammate to cover your on-call shift.
items.model_en: Could you cover my on-call shift this Saturday? I'll take yours next week.

items.prompt_en: Say one thing you couldn't do a year ago but can do now.
items.model_en: A year ago I couldn't write Apex tests confidently, but now I can.
